question_text: Find the variance for the discrete data 6, 7, 10, 12, 13, 4, 8, 12.

recall_prompt: Say how you would find the variance of eight numbers — what you find first, what you square, and what you divide.
insider_note: The deviations are squared here — the sum is 74, not the 22 the unsquared deviations give — and the question stops at the variance 9.25: adding a square root at the end makes the answer wrong.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Mean
steps.margin_note: First mark. Eight values, sum 72, mean 9. n = 8 is the divisor in both steps.
steps.memory_tip: 72/8 = 9. Variance is spread about the mean, so the mean comes before any squaring.

recall.must_convey: That the mean of the eight values is 72/8 = 9.
accept: add the eight numbers to get seventy two and divide by eight, the mean is nine
x bar is seventy two by eight equals nine
the mean of the data is nine
enimidi numbers add cheste seventy two, eight tho divide cheste mean nine
sum seventy two, n eight, mean nine

steps.why: Variance measures spread around the mean, so the mean has to exist before any deviation can be squared.
common_mistakes: Dividing by 7 because 12 appears twice — n = 8.

steps.label: Variance
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Deviations from 9 (signs kept), squared: 9, 4, 1, 9, 16, 25, 1, 9. Sum 74, divide by n = 8. 74/8 = 9.25. Only the variance is asked — no square root.
steps.memory_tip: Square the deviations, so 74 and not the 22 the unsquared ones give. Variance only — no square root here.

recall.must_convey: That the deviations from 9 are squared to 9, 4, 1, 9, 16, 25, 1, 9, their sum 74 divided by 8 gives the variance 9.25.
accept: subtract nine from each number, square, add to seventy four, divide by eight, nine point two five
the squared deviations add to seventy four and seventy four by eight is nine point two five
variance is sigma x i minus x bar squared by n equals seventy four by eight equals nine point two five
nine nunchi deviations square chesi add cheste seventy four, eight tho divide cheste nine point two five
the variance is nine point two five

steps.why: Variance is the mean of the squared deviations. Squaring removes the signs on its own, which is why the absolute value is not needed here.
common_mistakes: Adding the absolute deviations (22) instead of their squares (74) — that is mean deviation, not variance.
Taking a square root at the end — the question asks for the variance only.
Dividing by n − 1 = 7; this syllabus divides by n.
